name: Levodropropizine Solution 120 ml 1 Piece
description: The solution containing levodropropizine and ambroxol is used to treat coughs in respiratory conditions where both cough suppression and phlegm thinning are needed. This combination is useful when an irritating or dry cough is present along with mucus secretions in the lungs and airways. Mechanism of action This solution combines two active ingredients with complementary functions: Levodropropizine: Acts as a peripheral antitussive. It inhibits the cough reflex without affecting the central nervous system, helping to soothe dry and irritating coughs. It blocks the release of inflammatory substances that trigger coughing. Ambroxol: Works as a mucolytic and expectorant. It decreases the viscosity of mucus and stimulates its production and transport, facilitating the expulsion of phlegm. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
